messages.content: The draft wrongly says I rejected all sensors. I rejected sensor-only control without a failure plan; sensor with fallback was deferred and then adopted. Keep that distinction and the original draft.
The final will preserve the original timer rationale, the deferred fallback proposal, the rejection of sensor-only operation and the later adoption. The draft will remain a separate file.
I approve the corrected final narrative for this fictional example. Use a concise CURRENT with links to the complete evolution and final narrative; preserve the draft.
